title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: NYSORA's serratus patient view: the patient's left side from the front, head at the top, feet at the bottom, left arm abducted to the image right with the armpit visible.
teachingPoint: Probe head on the lateral chest wall below the breast toward the armpit, the probe lying front-to-back; needle in-plane, level, from the anterior side.
claims: Copies NYSORA Fig-9's composition: patient's left side, head up, arm abducted to the right (owner, 2026-10-03; concept only, not committed; NYSORA's side used instead of the house right at the owner's direction).

Probe head on the lateral chest wall below the breast on the mid-axillary line, the probe lying anterior-posterior toward the arm side (record: transverse over the mid-axillary line at the 4th-5th ribs).
Needle entering just anterior to the probe head, level, in line with it (record: in-plane from the superior-anterior end).
Labels: Linear probe, Block needle, Axilla, Breast.
